# Vulpkanin
## General Information
Vulpkanins' sharp claws make their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage.
Their animal-like digestive system can [color=lightgreen]digest raw meat and blood[/color] without ill effects. They are [color=palevioletred]poisoned[/color] by allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
The shape of their muzzle means they tend to spill some liquid when drinking.
They take [color=lightgreen]15% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=palevioletred]15% more Heat damage[/color]. Their dense fur makes them prefer a somewhat cooler temperature range than humans, and also makes them [color=palevioletred]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
## Leaping
Vulpkanins' digitigrade legs allow them to [color=lightgreen]leap impressive distances[/color]. This is useful for jumping over ground-based hazards (such as bottomless chasms), or as a quick burst of speed to escape a dangerous situation or chase someone down.
Be careful not to crash into anything mid-leap, or you'll [color=palevioletred]fall to the ground[/color] and drop what you're holding!
